weekPace.title: This week is moving
weekPace.body: You have reported {{stepsDoneThisWeek}} Steps done since the week began.
weekPace.body_direct: That is what the week holds so far. Keep going.
weekPace.body_explanatory: You have reported {{stepsDoneThisWeek}} Steps done since the week began. That is the record, not an estimate.
weekPace.body_warm: {{stepsDoneThisWeek}} Steps done since it began. That is real, whatever the rest of it brings.
weekPace.body_energizing: The week is yours so far. Keep it moving.

streakDays.title: {{streakDays}} days in a row
streakDays.body: You have shown up every one of them.
streakDays.body_explanatory: Your streak counts a day the moment you report anything done. It stands at {{streakDays}}.
streakDays.body_warm: That is a rhythm, not luck.
streakDays.body_energizing: Do not let today be the gap.

stepsTotal.title: {{stepsDoneTotal}} Steps behind you
stepsTotal.body: Every one of them was a decision you made.
stepsTotal.body_direct: That is the total so far.
stepsTotal.body_explanatory: Counted across every Journey you have run. Each one is a Step you reported yourself.
stepsTotal.title_warm: Look at what is already behind you
stepsTotal.body_warm: {{stepsDoneTotal}} Steps. None of them happened on their own.
stepsTotal.body_energizing: The number only goes one way. Add to it today.

journeyShare.title: {{journeyTitle}} is {{journeyProgressPct}}% done
journeyShare.body: That is the part you have already lived.
journeyShare.body_direct: Open it and take the next Step.
journeyShare.body_explanatory: That is the share of its Steps you have reported done, out of the ones still in the plan.
journeyShare.body_warm: {{journeyProgressPct}}% of it is already behind you.
journeyShare.body_energizing: The rest is the same kind of work. Keep going.

daysMoving.title: {{daysMoving}} days with {{journeyTitle}}
daysMoving.body: It has been part of your life for a while now.
daysMoving.body_explanatory: Counted from the day it started. It is still open, and still yours to move.
daysMoving.body_warm: It has been with you a while. That counts for something.
daysMoving.body_energizing: Long enough to be real. Keep it moving.

milestoneNear.title: Your Milestone is close
milestoneNear.title_explanatory: You are near the end of a Milestone
milestoneNear.body_explanatory: {{stepsToMilestone}} Steps remain in the Milestone you are working through right now.
milestoneNear.body_warm: {{stepsToMilestone}} Steps left. No rush, it is close.
milestoneNear.body_energizing: That is finishable. Go and take one.

backAfterMiss.title: You are back
backAfterMiss.body: Picking it up again is the part that matters.
backAfterMiss.body_explanatory: A gap does not undo what came before it. The plan continues from here.
backAfterMiss.body_warm: That is the hard part, and it is done.
backAfterMiss.body_energizing: The plan is waiting. Take the next one.

returnCounts.title: Nothing was lost
returnCounts.body_explanatory: The {{stepsDoneTotal}} Steps you have reported done are still counted. A pause does not reset them.
returnCounts.body_warm: {{stepsDoneTotal}} Steps behind you. A gap does not erase them.
returnCounts.body_energizing: You are not starting over. Keep going.

quietDoorOpen.title: Whenever you are ready
quietDoorOpen.body: Today's plan is here when you want it.
quietDoorOpen.body_explanatory: Your plan is still here and unchanged. You can pick it up from wherever you left it.
quietDoorOpen.body_warm: It is here when you want it. One Step is plenty.
quietDoorOpen.body_energizing: That is all today has to be.

quietStillYours.title: {{journeyTitle}} is still yours
quietStillYours.body_explanatory: It stays exactly as you left it until you move it, pause it, or close it.
quietStillYours.body_warm: It is waiting, and it is not going anywhere.
quietStillYours.body_energizing: Open it and pick one Step.
